items.rationale: The forty-seven prepositions connect a verb or noun to its complement, for instance approaching a face, counting senses, needing something or comparing beings. No instance belongs to de même, de sorte que or de quoi.

items.rationale: Que introduces a clause in the ordinary cases. In comparisons it means than; ne vivons ... que restricts to only; after moment, figure or vues it connects a relative clause. The que in à peine ... que remains for the expression review.
